text:
julia_sales: prospect (EU payroll aggregator) just sent an RFP: wants a 10-day EU-only POC, plus explicit proof that backups/archives for that tenant won't be replicated to non-EU regions during the window. they explicitly don't want Dedicated yet. can ops/infra provide that evidence?
omar_se: short: Hosted can be configured with tenant-level region affinity and we can create a timeboxed policy to prevent normal cross-region fallback for the POC. but note: some long-term archival processes are async and may have multi-region retention by default; we can isolate or pause those for the POC.
rita_ops: ops plan: we can suspend cross-region archival replication for the tenant's logs and snapshots during the 10-day window, enable netflow capture, and produce an archival-policy diff showing replication disabled. this is manual, requires a support ticket and runbook signoff. we'll also enable a scoped KMS key in EU and generate KMS audit logs.
julia_sales: good. procurement will want a short template sentence for the RFP Q: "Where are backups stored and are they ever copied outside EU?"
omar_se: suggested RFP phrasing: "During timeboxed POCs Redwood can suspend cross-region archival replication for the scoped tenant and provide verification artifacts (archival policy diff, netflow export, and KMS-region audit logs). For long-term contractual guarantees on archival residency, Redwood recommends Dedicated or Private deployments with customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM)."
nico_compliance: compliance note: we can sign a time-limited operational statement for the POC only; cannot give a perpetual archival residency guarantee in Hosted. we will include a sub-processor annex and mark any vendor control planes that have multi-region control planes. also: any pause to replication must be reversible and documented.
luis_fin: cost note for procurement: short POC-scoped archival suspension + ops support is a one-time professional services estimate (depends on effort, rough ballpark $1-6k). Dedicated migration cost: multi-month commit, typically 2-4x hosted unit economics depending on model and commit. we'll produce a formal quote post-POC scope.
julia_sales: the engineers also asked for a sample header they can use to steer traffic to EU during the POC.
omar_se: sample steer header to paste in their test harness:```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}
x-tenant-id: payroll-prospect-42
x-region-hint: eu-west-1
```
server-side we'll pin routing for the test tenant and disable fallback for the window.
rita_ops: deliverables we will hand to the customer after the POC: 1) archival-policy diff showing replication paused for tenant snapshots, 2) netflow CSV for tenant traffic, 3) KMS-region audit CSV for the scoped key, 4) processing path PNG, 5) sub-processor annex with flags for control-plane regions. we will not share raw pcaps.
julia_sales: timeline: they want to start in 6 business days. is that feasible?
rita_ops: feasible if sales returns signed scope + explicit POC window + authorizes the one-time ops change. ops slot availability required; estimate start in 3-6 business days after approval.
nico_compliance: i'll draft the one-paragraph POC operational statement for procurement that covers scope, monitoring signals, artifact list, and the limit of Hosted guarantees. will post here for review.
infra-bot: ticket RD-POC-2066 created and assigned to @rita_ops and @omar_se. action items: prepare runbook, enable scoped EU KMS, pause archival replication for tenant during POC. requested start in 6 business days.
julia_sales: great — i'll share this suggested RFP text and the customer's questionnaire once they send it. please tag me on the ticket. thanks team :thumbsup:
